description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyAttachmentAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for managing vacancy attachments within a recruitment module. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving vacancy attachment data, adhering to the OpenAPI specifications with detailed documentation annotations. The class utilizes a combination of Symfony-like request handling, validation rules, and service dependencies to perform its operations.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for handling vacancy attachment operations such as create, update, delete, and retrieve within the recruitment module. It uses traits and services for business logic execution, adheres to OpenAPI documentation standards, and incorporates validation rules for API request consistency.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for retrieving all vacancy attachments.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for validation rules when retrieving all attachments.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new vacancy attachment; processes request parameters, validates, saves the attachment, and returns the created model.

methods.name: setVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Sets vacancy ID, comment, and attachment type on a VacancyAttachment object from request parameters.

methods.name: setBase64Attachment
methods.description: Extracts base64 attachment data from request and sets filename, type, size, and content on a VacancyAttachment.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules required for creating a vacancy attachment.

methods.name: getAttachmentRule
methods.description: Provides the validation rule for the attachment part, ensuring it's a valid Base64 attachment with filename constraints.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides additional validation rules for optional parameters like comment and attachmentType, plus ensures vacancyId exists.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple vacancy attachments based on provided IDs, validating existence prior to deletion.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, primarily ensuring IDs are provided.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves attachments for a specified vacancy ID, including total count.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Internal method to fetch attachments by vacancy ID and compose a collection result with total count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation rule ensuring the vacancyId parameter exists and references an existing Vacancy entity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing vacancy attachment, optionally replacing its content if specified, and returns the updated model.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachment
methods.description: Maps VacancyAttachment entity fields into a RecruitmentAttachment DTO for response.
